title: Hygea3
tagline: Peer-to-Peer Medical File Sharing Network, with encryption. The DAPP is built with Lit Protocol, Arweave, and Bundlr.
description:
Hygea3 is a peer-to-peer medical file sharing network built using the Lit Protocol and Arweave (IPFS). Users can upload their own medical files and give access to hospitals and other providers while they travel, change providers, or in emergencies.

Hygea gives patients a chance to take control of their own medical data and not have to worry about the transfer of that information from their primary physician.
how_its_made:
Hygea3 uses the Lit Protocol to encrypt the files. Arweave for the decentralized files. The DAPP itself is in React.JS. Bundlr is used for transactions on the site. There may be NFTs added to the project later on.

Our team came together to push this project through. We are very proud.
